title: centranthus angustifolius subsp. battandieri
intro: Centranthus angustifolius subsp. battandieri, commonly known as Valerian Spur, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its calming effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include valepotriates, valeranone, and isovaleric acid, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, spasmolytic, and antiseptic properties. Additionally, Valerian Spur has been reported to possess antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
